title: Phone tapping, audits and unmarked cars after the leak
summary: Carlos Dosoza tells of Phone tapping, audits and unmarked cars after the leak, about 1996-1997 at Sao Paulo, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I started to notice that every time I picked up the phone to talk, there was someone on the other end listening

plain: Carlos Dosoza, a top surgeon who says his hospital in Sao Paulo, Brazil, operated on an alien, says that in 1996 and 1997, after word of the case got out, he came under watch. He says that every time he picked up the phone, someone was listening on the other end, and he also tells of audits and unmarked cars, which would suggest someone powerful wanted to keep the story quiet.
